ROUTE_SPLIT.description: A cable is drawn as separate pieces that meet end to end away from any item, so the system cannot read it as one route.
ROUTE_SPLIT.fix: Join the pieces into one cable.

RING_LABEL_MISMATCH.description: Ring shapes and ring labels do not match one to one: a ring has no label, or a label has no ring.
RING_LABEL_MISMATCH.fix: Make the rings and their labels match one to one.

WRONG_LAYER.description: An item or its label is drawn on the layer of another type.
WRONG_LAYER.fix: Move it to the suggested layer.

LABEL_MISSING.description: A symbol has no label, while other symbols of its type do.
LABEL_MISSING.fix: Add the label of its type.

LABEL_TYPE_MISMATCH.description: The label names another type than the item it belongs to (for example a joint 36 labelled 144).
LABEL_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the label or the item.

LABEL_LENGTH_MISSING.description: A cable label gives its type but no length.
LABEL_LENGTH_MISSING.fix: Write the length in the label.

HANDHOLE_TYPE_MISSING.description: The handhole is drawn but no text next to it says its type (DH, HH-I, HH-II or MH-I to MH-IV).
HANDHOLE_TYPE_MISSING.fix: Type the handhole type next to it.

HANDHOLE_TYPE_UNKNOWN.description: The text next to the handhole is not an accepted type: DH, HH-I (HH1), HH-II (CH) or MH-I to MH-IV.
HANDHOLE_TYPE_UNKNOWN.fix: Correct the text to one of the accepted types.

HANDHOLE_NOT_DRAWN.description: A handhole name is written (like 04A or CH01) but no handhole symbol is drawn at it.
HANDHOLE_NOT_DRAWN.fix: Draw the handhole at the name (or add it with the tool here on a handhole layer), or delete the name if it is not needed.

BOX_NUMBER_DUPLICATE.description: Two boxes in the same cabinet have the same number; a box number must be unique inside its cabinet.
BOX_NUMBER_DUPLICATE.fix: Change the number of one of the two boxes to the right one.

BOX_NOT_REACHED.description: No 1way bundle ends at this box, so it is not clear where it is connected from.
BOX_NOT_REACHED.fix: Fix the drawing in AutoCAD: connect a 1way bundle to the box.

CABINET_BOX_COUNT_MISMATCH.description: The box count written on the cabinet (like 22B) differs from the number of boxes drawn under it.
CABINET_BOX_COUNT_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the number written on the cabinet, or fix the drawn boxes in AutoCAD.

CABINET_ZONE_MISSING.description: There is no zone line (the cabinet area) around this cabinet.
CABINET_ZONE_MISSING.fix: Draw the zone line around the cabinet and its boxes in AutoCAD, or map the zone layer on the mapping screen.

SPARE_CORES_MISMATCH.description: The spare «SP n» is not the main cable cores minus the sum of the branch cable cores.
SPARE_CORES_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the spare number to the right result (written next to each place).

CABLE_SLACK_TOO_SHORT.description: The written cable is not at least 15 m longer than its bundle (or it is shorter than the bundle itself).
CABLE_SLACK_TOO_SHORT.fix: Correct the cable length in its label.

CABLE_SLACK_TOO_LONG.description: The written cable is more than 30 m longer than its bundle. This is a warning only and does not block publishing.
CABLE_SLACK_TOO_LONG.fix: Check the cable length if the number is wrong; if it is right, leave it as it is.

BOX_CABINET_UNKNOWN.description: A box names a cabinet that is not in the drawing. The name may have a typo.
BOX_CABINET_UNKNOWN.fix: Fix the cabinet name written on the box so it matches a cabinet in the drawing.

CABINET_NAME_DUPLICATE.description: Two cabinets in the drawing have the same name; each cabinet needs one unique name.
CABINET_NAME_DUPLICATE.fix: Rename one of the two cabinets.

CONNECTOR_SIZE_MISSING.description: A 1way bundle label has no duct size, so the connector and end-cap size is unknown.
CONNECTOR_SIZE_MISSING.fix: Write the duct size in the bundle label (e.g. 1way 20/16).

hints.move: Drag the symbol to its real position; it snaps to endpoints, vertices and symbols within 14 px.
